name: Pradhan Mantri Jan Dhan Yojana (PMJDY)
description: Zero balance savings bank account with accidental insurance cover for unbanked citizens.
eligibility: Any Indian citizen over 10 years of age without a bank account.

name: Ayushman Bharat Yojana
description: Health insurance scheme providing cover of up to ₹5 lakhs per family per year for secondary care and hospitalization.
eligibility: Low-income families listed in the SECC database.

name: PM Kisan Samman Nidhi
description: Income support of ₹6,000 per year in three equal installments to all landholding farmer families.
eligibility: Small and marginal farmers holding cultivable land.

name: Sukanya Samriddhi Yojana
description: A government-backed savings scheme for the parents of a girl child to build a fund for her future education and marriage.
eligibility: Parents or legal guardians of a girl child below 10 years of age.

name: Pradhan Mantri Mudra Yojana (PMMY)
description: Provides business loans up to ₹10 lakhs for non-corporate, non-farm small and micro enterprises to start or expand business.
eligibility: Any Indian citizen with a business plan for an income-generating activity.

name: Digital India Internship Scheme
description: Provides practical experience, stipend, and exposure to college students in the field of e-governance and Information Technology.
eligibility: College students pursuing undergraduate or postgraduate degrees in relevant fields.

name: National Social Assistance Programme (NSAP) / Old Age Pension
description: Provides financial assistance and monthly pension to the elderly, widows, and persons with disabilities.
eligibility: Senior citizens (60+ years), widows, and disabled individuals from Below Poverty Line (BPL) families.

name: Pradhan Mantri Awas Yojana (PMAY)
description: Provides affordable housing and financial assistance (subsidy on home loans) to the urban and rural poor to build their own houses.
eligibility: Economically Weaker Section (EWS), Low Income Groups (LIG), and people without a pucca house.

name: Pradhan Mantri Ujjwala Yojana (PMUY)
description: Provides free LPG gas connections to women from Below Poverty Line (BPL) households to ensure smokeless kitchens.
eligibility: Adult women belonging to BPL families without an existing LPG connection.

name: PM SVANidhi Yojana
description: A special micro-credit facility providing affordable loans up to ₹10,000 to street vendors to resume their livelihoods.
eligibility: Street vendors, hawkers, and people selling goods on footpaths or carts.

name: Pradhan Mantri Fasal Bima Yojana (PMFBY)
description: Crop insurance scheme that provides financial support to farmers in the event of crop failure or damage due to natural calamities.
eligibility: All farmers including sharecroppers and tenant farmers growing notified crops.

name: Atal Pension Yojana (APY)
description: A pension scheme for workers in the unorganized sector, providing a guaranteed minimum monthly pension of ₹1,000 to ₹5,000 after age 60.
eligibility: Indian citizens between 18 and 40 years of age with a bank account.

name: Stand-Up India Scheme
description: Facilitates bank loans between ₹10 lakh and ₹1 crore for setting up a greenfield enterprise in manufacturing, services, or trading.
eligibility: Women entrepreneurs, and individuals belonging to SC or ST categories above 18 years.

name: PM Vishwakarma Yojana
description: Provides financial assistance, skill training, and modern tools to traditional artisans and craftspeople like carpenters, goldsmiths, and blacksmiths.
eligibility: Traditional artisans and craftspeople working with their hands and tools.

name: Beti Bachao Beti Padhao
description: A campaign to generate awareness and improve the efficiency of welfare services intended for girls, focusing on education and survival.
eligibility: Families with girl children in selected districts with low Child Sex Ratio.
